entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I need to arrange a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. The name is David Chen, and the order number is VF88-12945.
Thank you, David. I have your order right here. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's definitely a technical fault. The main pulse sensor is just not working. I've charged it fully, reinstalled the app, but it won't sync my heart rate data correctly. It seems completely broken.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having that trouble. A device that won't sync is no use at all. It does sound like the unit could be defective. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I see here that the VeloBand was delivered to you 32 days ago. Looking at our policy, all our items have a 10-day return window, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, that's a relief. So I can just send the defective one back?

That's correct. I have just authorized the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Simply pack the item up and drop it at a post office.

That's great, Sarah. I do appreciate how simple that was. Now, I see you have me listed as a VIP member. Given the hassle with this broken device, would it be possible to get a small credit or a discount code for my trouble? I'd like to re-order it, and that would go a long way.

That is an excellent point, David, and I see you've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. We definitely want to make this right for you. For the inconvenience, I can add a $25 VeloFit credit directly to your account. You can use it on your replacement or any future purchase. How does that sound?
A $25 credit would be perfect. Thank you for taking care of that. It definitely makes me feel better about ordering again.

You're very welcome. The credit has been applied. Once we receive your return, the full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
